title: Settlements - Sim Explorer
description_html: Every simulation result in one place. shot_matrix and weapon_shot are derived-exact - closed-form over the locked core engine, recomputed on every build, no sampling error. sim_runs / sim_values are measured Monte-Carlo envelopes and carry engine / cost-table / harness fingerprints; a stale flag means something they depended on has moved since. Never average the two kinds together.

shot_matrix.description: Exact probability for any shot: stat x cover x extra to-hit modifier x armour x weapon damage x attack dice. 'over_mod_cap' flags rows where the raw modifier exceeded the +/-3 cap and was clamped.

columns.to_hit: P(the attack roll hits), 1d10 + stat + capped modifiers >= 7
columns.injure_given_hit: P(the Injury roll wounds), 1d10 + Damage - Armour >= 7
columns.wound_per_die: to_hit x injure_given_hit - one die's chance to wound
columns.stress_per_die: to_hit x (1 - injure_given_hit) - one die's chance to Pin (+1 Stress)
columns.p_wound_action: P(at least one wound) across the whole Action. At WND 1 this IS P(Down).
columns.e_wounds_resolve_all: E[wounds] if every die resolves regardless - correct vs WND 2-3 or if surplus dice may be redirected
columns.e_wounds_stop_on_down: E[wounds] if the sequence ends at Down - correct at WND 1 with dice locked to one target
columns.e_stress_stop_on_down: E[Stress applied] under the same stop rule
columns.p_break_test: P(>=2 Pins in one Action) - the Break-test trigger (2+ Stress)

weapon_shot.description: The same chain, but for every weapon in the shipped catalogue at its real Credits cost. 'fielded_credits' = cheapest body legally able to carry it + the weapon.

weapons.description: The shipped armoury, priced live from points/ticks.py at build time.

bodies.description: Rank body costs on the 850-Credit scale.

armour_costs.description: Armour is 10 / 20 Cr - measured directly with zero prior (armour-level-n2500).

sim_runs.description: Every stamped Monte-Carlo envelope in balance/results/. STALE means the engine, cost table or harness has moved since the run - the project deliberately prefers false-stale to false-fresh, so most older runs are flagged.

sim_values.description: Every measured value from those envelopes, flattened to one searchable row each.

search.description: Full-text across findings, weapons, skills and runs. Query with ?_search=...

chance_to_injure.title: 1. Chance to injure - pick a stat line and a weapon
chance_to_injure.description_html: The main lookup. stat is the shooter's DEX (-1 to +6), damage the weapon's Damage (+0 to +5), cover one of open/light/heavy/hidden, armour one of unarmoured/light/heavy. Leave dice at 1 for a normal weapon.
chance_to_injure.sql:
SELECT stat_label AS stat, damage_label AS weapon, cover, armour, attack_dice,
       ROUND(to_hit*100,1)            || '%' AS to_hit,
       ROUND(injure_given_hit*100,1)  || '%' AS injure_if_hit,
       ROUND(wound_per_die*100,1)     || '%' AS wound_per_shot,
       ROUND(p_wound_action*100,1)    || '%' AS wound_per_action,
       ROUND(stress_per_die*100,1)    || '%' AS pin_per_shot,
       ROUND(actions_to_down,2)              AS actions_to_down
FROM shot_matrix
WHERE stat = CAST(:stat AS INTEGER)
  AND damage = CAST(:damage AS INTEGER)
  AND cover = :cover
  AND armour = :armour
  AND attack_dice = CAST(:dice AS INTEGER)
  AND extra_to_hit = 0

one_stat_line_all_cover.title: 2. One stat line, every cover x armour band
one_stat_line_all_cover.description: Fix the shooter and the weapon; see the whole board. This is the table to read before pricing anything.
one_stat_line_all_cover.sql:
SELECT cover, armour,
       ROUND(to_hit*100,1)         || '%' AS to_hit,
       ROUND(wound_per_die*100,1)  || '%' AS wound_per_shot,
       ROUND(p_wound_action*100,1) || '%' AS wound_per_action,
       ROUND(e_stress_stop_on_down,3)     AS stress_per_action,
       ROUND(actions_to_down,2)           AS actions_to_down
FROM shot_matrix
WHERE stat = CAST(:stat AS INTEGER)
  AND damage = CAST(:damage AS INTEGER)
  AND attack_dice = CAST(:dice AS INTEGER)
  AND extra_to_hit = 0
ORDER BY cover_mod DESC, armour_mod DESC

weapon_lookup.title: 3. Named weapon vs a target
weapon_lookup.description: Type part of a weapon's name (e.g. 'rifle', 'axe', 'shotgun').
weapon_lookup.sql:
SELECT ws.weapon, ws.class, ws.damage, ws.weapon_credits AS weapon_cr,
       ws.carrier_rank, ws.fielded_credits AS fielded_cr,
       ws.stat AS shooter_stat, ws.cover, ws.armour, ws.attack_dice,
       ROUND(ws.to_hit*100,1)         || '%' AS to_hit,
       ROUND(ws.p_wound_action*100,1) || '%' AS wound_per_action,
       ROUND(ws.actions_to_down,2)           AS actions_to_down,
       ROUND(ws.wounds_per_action_per_100cr,3) AS wounds_per_100cr
FROM weapon_shot ws
WHERE ws.weapon LIKE '%' || :weapon_name || '%'
  AND ws.stat = CAST(:stat AS INTEGER)
  AND ws.cover = :cover
  AND ws.armour = :armour
ORDER BY ws.attack_dice, ws.weapon

attack_dice_ladder.title: 4. Attack Dice - the 15b ladder across every band
attack_dice_ladder.description_html: Both down-rules side by side. resolve_all assumes every die resolves; stop_on_down assumes the sequence ends when the target goes Down - the WND-1 default. The gap between them is the open ruling.
attack_dice_ladder.sql:
SELECT cover, armour, attack_dice AS dice,
       ROUND(p_wound_action*100,1) || '%' AS p_at_least_one_wound,
       ROUND(e_wounds_resolve_all,3)      AS e_wounds_all,
       ROUND(e_wounds_stop_on_down,3)     AS e_wounds_stop,
       ROUND((1 - e_wounds_stop_on_down/NULLIF(e_wounds_resolve_all,0))*100,1) || '%' AS overkill_wasted,
       ROUND(e_stress_stop_on_down,3)     AS e_stress,
       ROUND(p_break_test*100,1)   || '%' AS p_break_test
FROM shot_matrix
WHERE stat = CAST(:stat AS INTEGER) AND damage = CAST(:damage AS INTEGER)
  AND extra_to_hit = 0
ORDER BY cover_mod DESC, armour_mod DESC, attack_dice

credit_efficiency.title: 5. Credit efficiency - what is an auto-include?
credit_efficiency.description: Wounds per Action per 100 Credits FIELDED (body + weapon). The body belongs in the denominator: a weapon multiplies the output of a body, and the body is the expensive part.
credit_efficiency.sql:
SELECT weapon, class, carrier_rank, damage, weapon_credits AS weapon_cr,
       fielded_credits AS fielded_cr, attack_dice,
       ROUND(p_wound_action*100,1) || '%'      AS wound_per_action,
       ROUND(wounds_per_action_per_100cr,3)    AS wounds_per_100cr
FROM weapon_shot
WHERE stat = CAST(:stat AS INTEGER) AND cover = :cover AND armour = :armour
  AND attack_dice = 1
ORDER BY wounds_per_100cr DESC

current_findings.title: 6. Measured findings that are still current
current_findings.description: Values from stamped runs whose engine, cost table and harness fingerprints all still match today's. Everything else is flagged stale - see all_findings.
current_findings.sql:
SELECT v.run_name, v.path, v.value_num, v.value_text, v.created
FROM sim_values v JOIN sim_runs r ON r.file = v.run_file
WHERE r.stale = 0 AND v.path LIKE '%' || :contains || '%'
ORDER BY v.created DESC, v.path
LIMIT 500

all_findings.title: 7. Search every measured finding (incl. stale)
all_findings.description: Substring match on the value path. Try 'value', 'credits', 'wp', 'ratio', 'significant'.
all_findings.sql:
SELECT v.run_name, v.path, v.value_num, v.value_text, v.created,
       r.stale, r.stale_reason
FROM sim_values v JOIN sim_runs r ON r.file = v.run_file
WHERE v.path LIKE '%' || :contains || '%'
ORDER BY r.stale, v.created DESC
LIMIT 500

search_everything.title: 8. Search everything
search_everything.description: Full-text across findings, weapons, skills and run questions.
search_everything.sql:
SELECT kind, name, detail, value, source FROM search
WHERE search MATCH :q ORDER BY rank LIMIT 300

skill_lookup.title: 9. Skills by path / stat / tier
skill_lookup.description: Skills are never charged Credits to players (D22/D27); the figure is the designer-side value.
skill_lookup.sql:
SELECT name, path, tier, stat, unlocks_at, credits
FROM skills WHERE path LIKE '%' || :contains || '%'
   OR stat LIKE '%' || :contains || '%'
   OR name LIKE '%' || :contains || '%'
ORDER BY path, tier, name
